_comment: BindCraft target settings - APPROACH A: extracellular lumen plug (KlebC-like).
Site: the beta-barrel lumen of MtrE, entered from OUTSIDE the cell. The lumen
is an open funnel of pore radius 7.4-9.3 A (14.8-18.6 A diameter) running from
the extracellular mouth at z=+66 down to z=+34 - roughly 32 A of depth with NO
constriction anywhere along it. The periplasmic Asp ring (D422/D425 auth) is at
z=-46 and is NOT part of this site and NOT reachable from outside.
Mouth diameter (~15 A across the Q111 ring) admits a SINGLE alpha-helix with
side chains, not a helical hairpin. This matches the colicin E1 / TolC cryo-EM
structure (6WXI), where colicin binds as a single-pass folded helix.
Hotspots span the full insertion depth so BindCraft is forced to build a binder
that reaches down the barrel rather than capping the rim:
A123 Tyr  z=+57  shallow, lumen mouth
A311 Leu  z=+46  mid-barrel hydrophobic anchor
A132 Tyr  z=+41  deep aromatic anchor
VERIFY before running: key names against your installed BindCraft
settings_target/*.json - this file follows the v1.5.0 schema.
